post.summary: Look up address by zip code
post.description: Returns street, district, city and state of a Brazilian zip code (CEP) sent in the body. Returns 404 address.zipCodeNotFound when the zip code does not exist or the lookup service is unavailable. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

Validates e-mail and password and returns a JWT access token. Wrong password, unknown e-mail, deleted users and invited users who have not defined a password yet get the same 401. An inactive user with the right password gets 403 identity.accountDisabled. Five wrong passwords in a row lock the account for 15 minutes (429 identity.accountLocked with Retry-After). Limited to 5 attempts per minute per client IP (429 common.tooManyRequests with Retry-After).

Completes a sign in that answered requiresTwoFactor with the challenge id and the 6-digit code of the authenticator app. The challenge expires in 5 minutes and allows 5 attempts. Wrong or expired code: 401 identity.invalidTwoFactorCode.
Issues a new access token from the HttpOnly refresh cookie set at sign in and rotates the cookie. Missing, revoked or expired session: 401 identity.sessionExpired.
Revokes the session of the refresh cookie and deletes the cookie. Always 204.

Confirms the signed-in user with the password or, when two-factor is on, the authenticator code, and returns a single-use token valid for 5 minutes. Send it in the X-Reauthentication header of sensitive changes. Wrong proof: 422 auth.reauthenticationFailed.
Generates a new authenticator secret for the signed-in user and returns it with the otpauth URI for the QR code. Two-factor stays off until enabled with a valid code.
Turns two-factor on after checking a code of the authenticator app configured with the secret from setup. Without setup: 409 identity.twoFactorNotSetUp; wrong code: 400 identity.invalidTwoFactorCode.
Turns two-factor off and removes the secret. Requires the X-Reauthentication header (403 settings.reauthenticationRequired).

Returns the invited name, masked e-mail, role and expiry for the token sent in the body (never in the URL). Unknown token: 404 identity.invitationNotFound; expired: 422 identity.invitationExpired; used or replaced: 409 identity.invitationAlreadyUsed. Limited to 5 attempts per minute per client IP, counted apart from sign in.

Defines the password of an invited user with a strong password and consumes the single-use token. Same errors as inspect, plus 400 identity.weakPassword. Limited to 5 attempts per minute per client IP, counted apart from sign in.

get.description: Returns id, name, e-mail and role of the signed-in user.
Returns the rules with trigger, conditions, wait, actions, runs in the last 24 hours and last run. Roles: Admin, Manager.

post.description: Creates an enabled rule. 422 automations.invalid explains what to fix. Roles: Admin, Manager.

put.description: Replaces the definition of a rule. Roles: Admin, Manager.

delete.description: Deletes a rule and its run history. Roles: Admin, Manager.

put.description: Enables or disables a rule. Disabled rules skip pending runs. Roles: Admin, Manager.

get.description: Returns processed (last 24 hours), failed and pending items of each background queue. Roles: Admin, Manager.
Returns the failed automation runs and event deliveries with the error and attempts. Roles: Admin, Manager.

post.description: Puts a failed item back in its queue. Roles: Admin.

Returns vehicles, last visit, total spent, average ticket, open orders and situation (Active, OpenServiceOrder, NoReturn after 90 days) for up to 500 customers sent in the body. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

get.description: Returns the service orders of the customer from the newest with description, total, status and payment method. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

post.description: Starts the LGPD export of every personal data kept about the customer (record, vehicles, orders, access log). Poll GET /api/admin/jobs/{id} for the JSON file. Roles: Admin, Manager.
Imports customers from a CSV (nome;documento;telefone;email, up to 2 MB). Valid lines become customers; the job reports the errors by line. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

get.description: Returns the status and result of an export or import job. Exports are visible only to Admin and Manager. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.
Returns a page of customers ordered by name. Document, e-mail and phone come masked. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

post.description: Creates a customer with CPF or CNPJ, phone, optional e-mail and address (all or nothing) and the messaging consent (the server stamps the consent date). Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

Searches by name or full CPF/CNPJ sent in the body (never in the URL), filters by document type and sorts by name or creation date. Document, e-mail and phone come masked. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.
Returns one sensitive field (Document, Email or Phone) unmasked and records who saw it, when and why (View or Edit). Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

get.description: Returns one customer by id. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

put.description: Updates name, contact, address and messaging consent. The document cannot change. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

delete.description: Soft deletes a customer without open service orders or registered vehicles. Role: Admin.

post.description: Finds a customer by CPF or CNPJ sent in the body (never in the URL). Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

get.description: Returns revenue (cents), open orders, approval rate and receivable with the previous period, daily revenue split into services and parts, top services, yard by status and attention items. period: today, week or month (Brazil time). Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.
Returns the card order and visibility saved by the signed-in user. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

put.description: Saves the card order and visibility of the signed-in user (kpis, dailyRevenue, attention, topServices, yard). Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

post.description: Runs the suggested action of an attention item: CreatePurchaseOrder creates a draft purchase order, SendReminder and SendNewDeadline message the customer by e-mail when consented. The item leaves the list for 24 hours. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

get.description: Returns the frozen snapshot of an issued document (service order, quote or receipt). Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.
Returns the PDF of an issued document as a data URL with the file name. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

post.description: Sends the document to the customer by e-mail (when consented) or queues it for WhatsApp. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

get.description: Returns received amounts (delivered orders), receivables (completed and not paid), commissions per mechanic, totals by payment method and the latest receipts. Money in cents. period: today, week, month or quarter (Brazil time). Roles: Admin, Manager.
Lists the issued documents from the newest. Filter by kind (ServiceOrder, Quote, Receipt) and by part of the code. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.
Returns the plan of the shop, users in use against the limit, monthly usage and the enabled modules. Roles: Admin.

Returns indicators and a page of active parts with location, stock, minimum, outflow of the last 30 days, unit cost, last outflow and situation (Ok, Reorder, OutOfStock or Idle after 90 days without outflow). Filters: term (name or code), situation and location. Roles: all workshop roles.
Returns the stock item and its movements (In, Out, Adjustment) from the newest, with the user name and the service order number. Roles: all workshop roles.

post.description: Adds stock to a part with unit cost (the part cost is updated), reason, supplier and invoice number. Parts take whole units; supplies accept 3 decimals. Roles: Admin, Manager.
Removes stock from a part with reason and optional service order number. Not enough stock: 422 inventory.insufficientStock. Roles: Admin, Manager.
Returns the stock item of the EAN-13 barcode sent in the body. Unknown: 404 inventory.unknownBarcode. Roles: all workshop roles.

Reads the NF-e XML sent in base64 and returns supplier, number, date and lines, linked to parts by barcode and to the supplier by CNPJ. PDF or invalid file: 400 inventory.invalidInvoiceFile. Roles: Admin, Manager.
Registers one stock entry per invoice line with its unit cost. Roles: Admin, Manager.

get.description: Returns the stock counts from the newest. Roles: all workshop roles.

post.description: Opens a count of the active parts of a location with the current system quantities. One open count per location: 409 inventory.countAlreadyOpen. Roles: all workshop roles.

get.description: Returns one stock count with its lines. Roles: all workshop roles.

put.description: Saves the counted quantity of lines of an open count (null clears). Roles: all workshop roles.

post.description: Sends a fully counted count for approval. Missing lines: 422 inventory.countIncomplete. Roles: all workshop roles.
Approves a submitted count and records one adjustment movement per difference. Roles: Admin, Manager.
Rejects a submitted count with a reason; stock does not change. Roles: Admin, Manager.

get.description: Returns the suppliers by name. Roles: all workshop roles.

post.description: Creates a supplier with name, optional CNPJ (unique), e-mail and phone and the lead time in days (0 to 365). Roles: Admin, Manager.

put.description: Updates the supplier data. Roles: Admin, Manager.

get.description: Suggests quantities for parts below the minimum: up to the larger of twice the minimum or the 30-day outflow plus the minimum. Roles: Admin, Manager.
Returns the purchase orders from the newest. Roles: Admin, Manager.

post.description: Creates a draft purchase order for a supplier with part lines (quantity and unit cost). Roles: Admin, Manager.
Queues a draft order and e-mails it to the supplier; Sent when the e-mail goes out. Already sent: 409 inventory.orderAlreadySent. Roles: Admin, Manager.

get.description: Returns the average time in minutes from execution start to completion of completed or delivered service orders, optionally filtered by completion date (from and to, inclusive). Role: Admin.
Returns the 50 latest team notifications with the read flag of the signed-in user, hiding the types the user turned off in the app.

post.description: Marks the latest notifications as read for the signed-in user.
Marks one notification as read for the signed-in user.

get.description: Returns, per notification type, whether the signed-in user wants it in the app, by e-mail and by WhatsApp.

put.description: Saves the channels of each notification type for the signed-in user. E-mail copies go to the user's address.

get.description: Returns a page of packages ordered by name, with items, current item prices, items total and savings. The term filters by name. The status filters active or inactive packages; without status, only active packages are listed unless includeInactive is true. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant, Mechanic.

post.description: Creates an active package with name, optional description, 1 to 50 active services or parts (no repetition, quantity greater than zero), price greater than zero and an optional mileage suggestion. The first price goes to the price history. Roles: Admin, Manager.

get.description: Returns one package, active or inactive, with items total and savings. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant, Mechanic.

put.description: Replaces name, description, items, price and mileage suggestion of an active package. A new price goes to the price history. Inactive packages must be reactivated first. Roles: Admin, Manager.

get.description: Returns the package price changes, newest first, with the author name. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant, Mechanic.

post.description: Hides the package from the default listing and blocks changes. Roles: Admin, Manager.
Returns an inactive package to the default listing and allows changes again. Roles: Admin, Manager.

get.description: Returns a page of parts and supplies ordered by name. The term filters by name or exact code. The status filters active or inactive parts; without status, only active parts are listed unless includeInactive is true. The cost is returned only to Admin and Manager. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant, Mechanic.

post.description: Creates an active part or supply with unique code, name, type, unit of measure, sale price, cost, minimum stock, optional supplier and optional EAN-13 barcode. The stock starts at zero. The first cost and price go to the price history. Roles: Admin, Manager.

get.description: Returns one part, active or inactive, with stock. The cost is returned only to Admin and Manager. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant, Mechanic.

put.description: Updates code, name, type, unit of measure, sale price, cost, minimum stock, supplier and barcode. The stock does not change here. New cost or price values go to the price history. Roles: Admin, Manager.

delete.description: Logical delete: same rule as deactivate (the part leaves the default listing and new service orders, history is kept). Already inactive: 409. Used by an active package: 409 catalog.usedByActivePackage. Roles: Admin, Manager.

get.description: Returns the cost and sale price changes of one part, newest first, with the author name. Cost changes are returned only to Admin and Manager. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant, Mechanic.

post.description: Hides the part from the default listing and blocks new service order items. A part used by an active package returns 409 catalog.usedByActivePackage with the package names. Roles: Admin, Manager.
Returns an inactive part to the default listing. Roles: Admin, Manager.

Checks the link token sent in the body and returns how many confirmation attempts are left. 404 portal.linkUnavailable for unknown or expired links, 423 portal.locked after 3 wrong attempts. Anonymous.

Confirms the customer with the last 3 digits of the phone and opens a 1-hour session sent back in the body. Wrong digits return WrongDigits with attempts left; the third wrong attempt locks the link (423). Anonymous.

get.description: Returns the service order of the portal session: status timeline, photos, quote items, payment and documents. Requires the X-Portal-Session header. Anonymous.
Returns one photo of the service order linked to the portal session (header X-Portal-Session). The order view only carries the photo path.

post.description: Approves the chosen quote items. Items left out stay out of the order; the order moves to InProgress. 409 portal.alreadyAnswered when the quote is not pending. Requires X-Portal-Session. Anonymous.
Rejects the quote with a reason of at least 5 characters and sends the order back to diagnosis. Requires X-Portal-Session. Anonymous.
Creates a 30-minute Pix charge for the approved amount with copy-and-paste code and QR code. 422 portal.nothingToPay or portal.pixUnavailable. Requires X-Portal-Session. Anonymous.

get.description: Returns Pending, Paid or Expired for a charge of the portal session. Requires X-Portal-Session. Anonymous.

post.description: Starts a card checkout when a card provider is configured; otherwise 422 portal.cardUnavailable. Requires X-Portal-Session. Anonymous.

get.description: Returns a document of the portal session order. Requires X-Portal-Session. Anonymous.
Returns the PDF of a document of the portal session order as a data URL. Requires X-Portal-Session. Anonymous.
Tells whether a document code was issued by the shop, with kind, number, date and total. Anonymous.

post.description: Marks a Pix charge as paid and issues the receipt. The X-Pix-Signature header carries the HMAC-SHA256 of the txId with the configured secret. Anonymous.
Returns status, items and quote of a service order when the number and the customer CPF or CNPJ sent in the body match. Anonymous.
Approves the pending quote identified by the link token, deducts the parts from stock and moves the service order to InProgress in the same transaction. The token is single use. Anonymous.

get.description: Returns the latest version of each quote from the newest, with total, delivery and pending approval. Filter by status (Pending, Approved, Rejected). Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

post.description: Creates the quote of a service order with the items the mechanic chose and the default payment settings. One quote per order: 409 quotes.alreadyExists. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

get.description: Returns the open service orders that do not have a quote yet. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.
Returns the quote with customer (masked contact and consent), vehicle, diagnosis, items, discount, payment plan, approval, delivery and totals. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

Returns active packages, services and parts (with stock and lead time), suggestions from the diagnosis, discount rules, the discount limit of the signed-in user, payment settings and expiration choices. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

put.description: Replaces items, discount mode (Automatic, Manual, None), manual discount and payment plan of an editable quote (pending and not sent, or sent and failed or expired). Locked: 409 quotes.locked. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

post.description: Asks a manager to approve a manual discount above the limit of the signed-in user. Within the limit: 422 quotes.approvalNotNeeded. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.
Approves the pending discount request. Roles: Admin, Manager.
Rejects the pending discount request. Roles: Admin, Manager.
Returns a ready message for the customer with first name, vehicle, plate, total and deadline. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

Sends the quote by WhatsApp (returns the wa.me link), e-mail or link with a portal link that expires in the chosen days, and moves the service order to WaitingApproval. Needs customer consent for the channel (422 quotes.noConsent), items, positive total and, for a discount above the limit, an approved request (422 quotes.approvalRequired). Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

get.description: Returns the delivery status (Queued, Sent, Opened when the customer opens the portal, Failed). Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

post.description: Sends again a failed or expired delivery with a new link valid for 7 days. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.
Approves the quote in person: the service order goes to InProgress and parts are deducted from stock. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.
Rejects the quote with a reason of 5 or more characters; the service order goes back to InDiagnosis. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.
Creates a new pending version from the latest rejected version, copying items and discount. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

get.description: Returns every version of the quote from the newest, with items and totals. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

post.description: Runs a report over delivered service orders: measure (revenue, orderCount, partsOut, averageTicket, margin, commission) grouped by month, week, mechanic, service, category, payment method or customer. Money in cents. 422 reports.incompatible for combinations that do not make sense. Roles: Admin, Manager.

get.description: Returns the saved reports with definition and schedule, most recently changed first. Roles: Admin, Manager.

post.description: Saves a report definition with a unique name (3-80 characters). Roles: Admin, Manager.

put.description: Renames a saved report and replaces its definition. Roles: Admin, Manager.

delete.description: Deletes a saved report and its schedule. Roles: Admin, Manager.

put.description: Sets the weekly e-mail of a saved report (weekday, HH:mm Brazil time, up to 10 recipients, xlsx or pdf) or removes it with null. Roles: Admin, Manager.

post.description: Exports a report to Excel (xlsx) or PDF. The job returns the file as a data URL. Roles: Admin, Manager.

get.description: Returns the status and the file of a report export. Roles: Admin, Manager.

post.description: Turns a question in Portuguese (8-300 characters) into a report definition with a short explanation. Runs locally, no external AI. 422 assistant.notUnderstood when no measure is recognized. Roles: Admin, Manager.

get.description: Returns a page of service orders from the newest to the oldest, optionally filtered by status. To filter by license plate use POST /api/admin/service-orders/search (the plate never goes in the URL). Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant, Mechanic.

post.description: Opens a service order in Received for an existing customer and one of the customer's vehicles, with the problem described by the customer, an optional promised date and the mileage at intake (defaults to the vehicle mileage). A vehicle with an open order gets 409 serviceOrder.vehicleHasOpenOrder. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.
Same page as the list, filtered by exact license plate and optional status. The plate goes in the body because personal data never goes in the URL. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant, Mechanic.

get.description: Returns one service order with customer, vehicle, services, parts, current quote, status history and dates. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant, Mechanic.
Returns one photo of the service order (content type and data URL). Lists and details only carry the photo path, so each photo loads on demand. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant, Mechanic.

post.description: Approves the pending quote in person, deducts the parts from stock and moves the service order to InProgress in the same transaction. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

Moves the order to the next status with the version the client saw: Received to InDiagnosis, InDiagnosis to WaitingApproval (sends the quote; needs items), WaitingApproval to InProgress (approves and deducts stock) or back to InDiagnosis (rejects; reason with 5 or more characters), InProgress to Completed and Completed to Delivered. Stale version: 409 serviceOrders.versionConflict; other moves: 422 serviceOrder.invalidTransition. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.
Starts the work timer of the signed-in mechanic on an order in InDiagnosis or InProgress. Does nothing when a timer is already running. Roles: Admin, Manager, Mechanic.
Stops the running work timer and records the minutes. Roles: Admin, Manager, Mechanic.

get.description: Returns the open orders of the signed-in mechanic plus the unassigned ones waiting for a mechanic, by promised date. Roles: Admin, Manager, Mechanic.
Returns the mechanic sheet of an order: complaint, checklist, photos, diagnosis, sent to quote and running timer. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant, Mechanic.

put.description: Marks checklist items as Ok, Attention, Replace or empty (null). Unknown item ids are ignored. Roles: Admin, Manager, Mechanic.

post.description: Adds a JPG, PNG or WebP photo as a data URL up to 5 MB. The clientId makes the upload idempotent for the offline queue. Roles: Admin, Manager, Mechanic.

put.description: Saves the diagnosis text written by the mechanic. Roles: Admin, Manager, Mechanic.

post.description: Suggests active catalog services and parts for the described symptoms (suspension, brakes, oil, ignition), with confidence and reason. Roles: Admin, Manager, Mechanic.
Adds the chosen catalog services and parts (quantity 1, not repeated) to an order in InDiagnosis and marks it ready for the desk to send the quote. Roles: Admin, Manager, Mechanic.
Takes the order for the signed-in mechanic. A Received order moves to InDiagnosis; an InProgress order starts the timer. Roles: Admin, Manager, Mechanic.
Stops the timer and moves an InProgress order to Completed. Roles: Admin, Manager, Mechanic.

get.description: Returns a page of services ordered by name. The term filters by name or description. The status filters active or inactive services; without status, only active services are listed unless includeInactive is true. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant, Mechanic.

post.description: Creates an active catalog service with name, optional description, base price greater than zero, estimated time in minutes greater than zero, commission from 0 to 50 percent, warranty from 0 to 3650 days and the parts usually used (existing parts, no repetition). The first price goes to the price history. Roles: Admin, Manager.

get.description: Returns one service by id, active or inactive (see isActive). Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant, Mechanic.

put.description: Updates name, description, base price, estimated time, commission, warranty and usual parts of an active service. A new base price goes to the price history. Inactive services must be reactivated first. Items already added to service orders keep their copied price. Roles: Admin, Manager.

delete.description: Logical delete: same rule as deactivate (the service leaves the default listing and new service orders, history is kept). Already inactive: 409. Used by an active package: 409 catalog.usedByActivePackage. Roles: Admin, Manager.

get.description: Returns the base price changes of one service, newest first, with the author name. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant, Mechanic.

post.description: Hides the service from the default listing, blocks changes and blocks new service order items. Items already added to service orders are kept. A service used by an active package returns 409 catalog.usedByActivePackage with the package names. Roles: Admin, Manager.
Returns an inactive service to the default listing and allows changes and new service order items again. Roles: Admin, Manager.

get.description: Returns name, CNPJ, address, logo, business hours and plan of the shop. Roles: Admin, Manager.

put.description: Saves name, CNPJ, address and business hours. Requires a fresh X-Reauthentication token (403 settings.reauthenticationRequired). Roles: Admin.

post.description: Saves the shop logo sent as a PNG or JPG data URL up to 512 KB. Requires a fresh X-Reauthentication token (403 settings.reauthenticationRequired). Roles: Admin.

get.description: Returns the automatic discount rules and the discount limit of each role. Roles: Admin, Manager.

put.description: Replaces the discount rules and role limits. Requires a fresh X-Reauthentication token (403 settings.reauthenticationRequired). Roles: Admin.

get.description: Returns accepted methods, installments, interest, fees and the Pix key. Roles: Admin, Manager.

put.description: Saves methods, installments, interest, fees and the Pix key (null keeps the current key). Requires a fresh X-Reauthentication token (403 settings.reauthenticationRequired). Roles: Admin.

get.description: Returns the message templates and the send window. Roles: Admin, Manager.

put.description: Saves the templates (only known variables) and the send window. Requires a fresh X-Reauthentication token (403 settings.reauthenticationRequired). Roles: Admin.

get.description: Returns the two-factor policy, idle timeout and lockout rules. Roles: Admin.

put.description: Saves the two-factor policy, idle timeout (5-60 min) and lockout rules. Requires a fresh X-Reauthentication token (403 settings.reauthenticationRequired). Roles: Admin.

get.description: Returns the active sessions of every user with device and last activity; the caller's session is marked current. Roles: Admin.

delete.description: Ends another active session; its refresh token stops working. The current session cannot be ended here (404). Requires a fresh X-Reauthentication token (403 settings.reauthenticationRequired). Roles: Admin.

post.description: Searches settings changes, discount approvals, revealed personal data and stock adjustments by area, period and actor, newest first. Roles: Admin.

get.description: Returns the status of NFS-e, NF-e and NFC-e integrations. Roles: Admin, Manager.

post.description: Returns specialties, commission, discount limit and weekly schedule for each user id in the body (up to 500). Users without a profile get an empty one. Roles: Admin, Manager.

get.description: Returns the professional profile of one user, or an empty profile when none was saved. Roles: Admin, Manager.

put.description: Saves up to 8 specialties (2 to 40 characters), commission from 0 to 50 percent, discount limit from 0 to 30 percent (always 0 for mechanics: 422 team.mechanicDiscount) and one shift per weekday in HH:mm with start before end. Role: Admin.

post.description: Returns, for each user id in the body and the last 30 or 90 days, the service orders worked, hours recorded on the timer, occupancy against the weekly schedule (44 hours when none), revenue of those orders, rework percent and the orders per week. Roles: Admin, Manager.

get.description: Returns the permissions of each role. Roles are fixed in this version (customizable false). Roles: Admin, Manager.

put.description: Role permissions are fixed in this version: always 422 roles.customizationUnavailable. Role: Admin.

get.description: Returns a page of users ordered by name, optionally filtered by role and status (Active, Inactive or InvitationPending). Roles: Admin, Manager.

post.description: Creates a user with any role (Admin, Manager, Attendant or Mechanic), unique e-mail and strong password. Role: Admin.
Creates a user without password and e-mails a single-use link (valid for 72 hours) where the person defines their own password. Nobody, not even the Admin, sees the password. Role: Admin.
Revokes the open invitation and e-mails a new link. Only for users who have not defined a password yet. Role: Admin.

get.description: Returns one user by id. Roles: Admin, Manager.

put.description: Changes name and role. An Admin cannot demote themselves, and the last active Admin cannot be demoted. Role: Admin.

delete.description: Deactivates and soft deletes a user. An Admin cannot delete themselves or the last active Admin. Role: Admin.

post.description: Blocks the user from signing in. An Admin cannot deactivate themselves or the last active Admin. Role: Admin.
Allows an inactive user to sign in again. Role: Admin.
Finds a user by e-mail sent in the body (never in the URL). Role: Admin.

get.description: Returns a page of vehicles ordered by brand. To find a vehicle by license plate, use POST /api/admin/vehicles/search. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant, Mechanic.

post.description: Creates a vehicle with license plate, brand, model, year and mileage for an existing customer. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

get.description: Returns every vehicle of one customer, ordered by brand and model. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant, Mechanic.

post.description: Finds one vehicle by exact license plate. The plate goes in the body, never in the URL. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant, Mechanic.

get.description: Returns one vehicle by id, with its owner and service order history. Roles: Admin, Attendant, Mechanic.

put.description: Updates brand, model, year and mileage. The license plate cannot change; the owner changes through the transfer endpoint. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.

delete.description: Soft deletes a vehicle without open service orders. Role: Admin.

post.description: Moves the vehicle to another existing customer, keeping its service order history. Roles: Admin, Manager, Attendant.
